value.title: Explain Unisphere purpose installation and SDK integration
value.summary: Explain Unisphere purpose, install/reinstall and telemetry SDK usage; add practical contribution guidance without product semantics changes.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Public onboarding for the landed Rust SDK/CLI, a safely quoted checkout-based just install recipe, and conditional missing-harness setup guidance.

sections.name: goals
value: Readers understand standard native telemetry projection and caller-owned integration/reporting.
Users install/reinstall from the checkout and execute real CLI/SDK examples.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No operator binary overwrite during validation, global setup change or workspace retirement.

value.claim: README explains purpose, common OTLP output, supported native dialects and actual fidelity/privacy/rerun boundaries without claiming universal coverage or a central service.
The documented external SDK telemetry example compiles and runs with all four exact path dependencies, caller-owned output and full bounded-batch cursor handling.
The documented CLI examples execute on synthetic explicit input with metadata/content/output/error streams matching the shipped contract.

just install rebuilds and reinstalls the checkout CLI into a safely quoted prefix, defaults to ~/.local, succeeds twice in a temporary prefix and runs installed version/catalog smoke without global setup or unrelated file changes.

CONTRIBUTING gives practical architecture, adapter/loader/output, privacy/testing and contribution guidance; AGENTS links the exact upstream setup guide only if harness is unavailable, preserving existing governance/commit rules.
All documentation links resolve; no shipped Rust product code, dependencies, lockfile or existing operator installation changes.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: Four requested public onboarding files completed; real README SDK/CLI examples and twice-run prefix-safe just install proved. Main consumer review found no material issue. No Rust product semantics, dependency, operator install or global setup change. Scoped PR/CI/landing remains next.
